description: Collect GitHub Marketplace apps, integrations and GitHub Actions listings: search by keyword, browse a category, or look up exact slugs and URLs. Returns pricing plans, install counts, verified-creator status, publisher details, permissions and Action repository stats.

category.description: Marketplace category (mode=byCategory, or as an extra filter in the search modes).
category.title: Category

categoryType.description: Whether to browse apps or Actions in mode=byCategory.
categoryType.title: Category listing type

maxItems.description: Maximum number of listings to save.
maxItems.title: Max listings

minInstalls.description: Only return apps with at least this many installations. Actions have stars instead, so this filter excludes them.
minInstalls.title: Minimum installs (apps)

minStars.description: Only return Actions whose repository has at least this many stars. Apps have install counts instead, so this filter excludes them.
minStars.title: Minimum stars (Actions)

mode.description: What to collect from GitHub Marketplace.
enumTitles: Look up exact slugs or URLs
mode.title: Mode

owners.description: Keep only listings published by these GitHub accounts, e.g. 'actions' or 'hashicorp'. Case-insensitive. Needs detail data, which the actor always fetches.
owners.title: Publisher logins (optional)

planType.description: Filter by pricing model. Free-trial filtering is server-side; free/paid are checked against each listing's published plans.
planType.title: Pricing

searchQuery.description: Keyword to search for (mode=searchApps, searchActions, searchAll). Leave empty to browse the most popular listings.
searchQuery.title: Search query

slugs.description: Listing slugs, marketplace paths or full URLs, e.g. 'codecov', 'github-pages', '/marketplace/actions/checkout' or 'https://github.com/marketplace/snyk'. Apps and Actions are detected automatically.
slugs.title: Slugs or URLs (mode=bySlug)

verifiedOnly.description: Only return listings from GitHub-verified creators.
verifiedOnly.title: Verified creators only

title: GitHub Marketplace Scraper Input
